description: Audits EVM token contracts for honeypots, transfer traps, blacklist bytecode, and calculates a composite vulnerability score and liquidity ceiling.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID (e.g., 8453 for Base, 1 for Ethereum Mainnet, 56 for BSC). Defaults to 8453.

max_acceptable_tax_pct.description: Maximum allowable cumulative buy/sell tax threshold percentage. Defaults to 5.0%.

token_address.description: The EVM contract address of the target token to evaluate.

name: contract_security_screener

risk_metrics.description: Composite risk score (0-100) and max position ceiling

tax_audit.description: Audit of buy, sell, and transfer taxes
